description: Marion, IA – Ashley Hinson handily won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate tonight. “It has been working Iowans from all 99 counties – and I’ve visited every single one of them – who powered this campaign and delivered a resounding victory tonight,” Hinson said. “We’re going to continue fighting every day to make life more affordable for Iowa families, to take on Big Pharma and Big Health Insurance, and to root out corruption in Washington by banning Members of Congress and their spouses from trading stocks and participating in prediction markets. “Voters sent me to Washington to share their stories and be their voice in the fight to make life more affordable, safer, and easier for their families. My record is one of delivering bipartisan results for Iowans, and that’s exactly what I’ll do in the United States Senate. I’ll work with anyone, from any party, to get things done for Iowa.” ###
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ASHLEY FOR IOWA
title: Ashley Hinson Wins Republican Primary and Will Win in November - Ashley Hinson for Iowa
